instrument_name: KRS 337.275 Minimum wage
figure_or_rule_carried: State minimum wage 7.25/h from 2009-07-01; automatically follows any federal 29 USC 206(a)(1) increase; tipped employee (more than 30 USD/month in tips) may be paid the federal tipped cash wage (29 USC 203) with records proving tips + wage reach the minimum; no 2027 state increase in text (statute effective 2007-06-26 version). Wayback capture 20260928.

instrument_name: KRS 337.285 Overtime over 40 hours
figure_or_rule_carried: 1.5x regular rate for hours over 40 in a workweek; exemptions: retail selling, restaurant/hotel/motel, FLSA 213(b)(1)(6)(10)(17), residential childcare, third-party companionship; county/city employees and Trooper/CVE R class may take comp time (240/480 h caps; payout at termination at higher of 3-yr average or final rate). Effective 2024-04-05.

instrument_name: KRS 337.050 Seventh-day overtime
figure_or_rule_carried: Employee permitted to work 7 days in a workweek is paid 1.5x for time worked on the 7th day; not applicable where employee is not permitted to work more than 40 h in the week (credit for other overtime paid); exclusions for small telephone exchanges, stenographers/bookkeepers of licensed professions, railway/water transport, supervisors.

instrument_name: KRS 337.020 Time of payment of wages
figure_or_rule_carried: Pay at least semimonthly all wages earned to a day not more than 18 days before payday; absent/unpaid employee paid within 6 days of demand; not applicable to KRS 337.010(2)(a)2 exempt (executive/admin/professional/outside sales).

instrument_name: KRS 337.055 Final pay on dismissal or voluntary leaving
figure_or_rule_carried: All wages earned paid not later than the next normal pay period after separation or 14 days after separation, whichever is later; same rule for discharge and resignation; 14 days on demand if absent. Wayback capture 20250725 (no later amendment in the chapter index).

instrument_name: KRS 337.010 Definitions (wages incl. vested vacation pay; payment methods; minimum-wage exclusions)
figure_or_rule_carried: Wages include vested vacation pay, overtime, severance, earned bonuses; payable in legal tender, checks, direct deposits or payroll card accounts (no activation fee; at least 1 free withdrawal per pay period up to full balance). Min-wage/overtime (KRS 337.275-.325) exclude: agriculture; exec/admin/professional/outside sales; federal employees; domestic service in a private home (unless more than one domestic regularly employed); certificated learners/apprentices/students/disabled workers; retail/service/hotel/restaurant under 95,000 USD gross for 5 years or family members; babysitters/companions; newspaper delivery; state employees under KRS 7,16,27A,30A,18A; seasonal camps; residential carers; direct sellers (IRC 3508(b)(2)); contracted baseball players. Effective 2026-04-10 (2026 Ky. Acts ch. 72 sec. 6).

instrument_name: KRS 337.060 Withholding of wages and prohibited deductions
figure_or_rule_carried: No deduction from agreed wage unless authorised by local/state/federal law or expressly authorised in writing by the employee (insurance, medical dues, etc.); union dues only with written consent for CBAs from 2017-01-09; never deduct fines, common-till cash shortages, breakage, dishonoured checks (where employee has discretion), or losses from faulty work/theft/damage/customer default unless wilful.

instrument_name: KRS 337.065 Gratuities and tip pooling
figure_or_rule_carried: Employer may not require remittance of tips except for legally required withholding; tip pools may include tipped employees but not salaried employees, managers or supervisors. Amended 2026 Ky. Acts ch. 72 sec. 7, effective 2026-04-10.

instrument_name: KRS 141.020 Individual income tax rate, reduction mechanism, nonresidents
figure_or_rule_carried: Rate 4.5% TY2023; 4% TY2024-2025; 3.5% for taxable years from 2026-01-01 (141.020(2)(f)). TY2027+: rate may be reduced only if the Office of State Budget Director reports reduction conditions met (Sept 5 report) AND the General Assembly acts; if not, the department maintains the (f) rate. Section effective 2025-06-27 (2025 Ky. Acts ch. 1 and ch. 98); chapter index 'enactments through the 2026 Regular Session', updated 10/19/2026, shows no later version, so statute text carries 3.5% for TY2027 absent further action. Nonresidents taxed only on income from labour performed/business in KY (4); part-year residents split (6). Wayback capture 20261011.

instrument_name: KRS 141.310 Withholding of tax from wages
figure_or_rule_carried: Employer withholds per KRS 141.315 / tables under 141.370; tables consider the standard deduction (5); wages may, at employer election, be computed to the nearest dollar (4) - this is the statutory rounding rule behind the cents-vs-dollars inconsistency in the 2026 formula examples [US-KY-002]; miscellaneous payroll period by days (2)-(3); quarterly averaging permitted by regulation (7); voluntary additional withholding (8); offsets for KRS 154 job assessment fees (9)-(13),(15); bond up to 50,000 (14); film-incentive companies withhold at the maximum 141.020 rate (17). Effective 2023-06-29; statute id unchanged in the 10/2026 chapter index (capture 20250312).

instrument_name: KRS 141.335 Annual withholding statement to employee
figure_or_rule_carried: Statement (W-2) to each employee by January 31 of the following year or, on termination, on the day of the last wage payment: employer name, employee name and SSN, total wages (KRS 141.010), total KY tax withheld; duplicate filed per regulation = the return under KRS 141.150; extensions up to 30 days by regulation.

instrument_name: KRS 341.030 Wages defined; taxable wage base and trust-fund trigger
figure_or_rule_carried: Taxable wage base 8,000 then 9,000 from 2012-01-01, +300 each January 1 up to a cap of 12,000; increase suspended/limited when the trust fund balance on Sept 30 is below/near 200,000,000 (7)(b)-(f); 2021-2022 increase suspended. Derivation: 11,400 (2024) + 300 = 11,700 (2025) + 300 = 12,000 (2026) = cap, so 2027 base = 12,000 unless amended. Effective 2022-03-24 (capture 20261023).

instrument_name: 42A003 (rev. March 2026) re-read: filing frequency thresholds, W-2 transmission, EFT, penalties
figure_or_rule_carried: Frequencies by annual KY tax withheld: under 400 annual K-3 by Jan 31; 400-1,999 quarterly K-1 (last day of month after quarter; Q4 on K-3 Jan 31); 2,000-49,999 monthly K-1 by 15th of next month (Dec on K-3 Jan 31); 50,000+ twice-monthly (1st-15th due 25th; 16th-end due 10th next month); 100,000+ accumulated in a period = pay within one banking day by EFT (103 KAR 1:060). All frequencies e-file/pay via MyTaxes. W-2 data to DOR by Jan 31 via MyTaxes transmitter (SSA EFW2 with DOR-defined RS record) or CD, or Form K-5; 26+ statements must be electronic (103 KAR 18:050(4)); paper W-2s not processed; corrections on paper W-2c. K-4 exemptions: no prior/current liability, Fort Campbell nonresident, SCRA/MSRRA, reciprocal-state residents. Penalties: late file/pay 2% per 30 days up to 20% (min 10); W-2 not furnished 25 each (min 100); non-electronic 10 per return. Registration: combined Form 10A100.

instrument_name: KRS 427.010 Exempt disposable earnings (garnishment limit)
figure_or_rule_carried: Garnishment of aggregate disposable earnings per workweek limited to the lesser of 25% of disposable earnings or the amount above 30 x federal minimum hourly wage (7.25 -> 217.50/week); other pay periods use the federal multiple; limits do not apply to support orders, Chapter 13 orders, or state/federal tax debts (those follow their own rules, e.g. CCPA 15 USC 1673(b)). Same as CCPA. Capture 20250620; id unchanged in 2026 index.

instrument_name: KRS 337.355 Lunch period; KRS 337.365 Rest periods
figure_or_rule_carried: Reasonable lunch period between the 3rd and 5th hour of the shift (no pay rule stated; CBA/mutual agreement may override); paid rest period of at least 10 minutes per 4 hours worked, in addition to lunch, with no reduction in compensation (337.365, effective 2020-03-27); railway-labor-act employees excluded.

instrument_name: KRS 337.015 Adoptive leave and parity of paid leave
figure_or_rule_carried: On written request, reasonable personal leave up to 6 weeks (or the employer's longer birth-parent leave) for reception of an adoptive child under 10; any paid leave or benefits given to birth parents must be given in the same type, amount and duration to adoptive parents; excludes relative/step/foster-child adoptions.

instrument_name: KRS 337.415 Court-ordered appearance (no discharge)
figure_or_rule_carried: No discharge for time off required by law to appear in court or an administrative tribunal after notice with the certificate; no pay obligation stated.

instrument_name: KRS 341.030(7)(a) multistate wage-base credit (covered employment under another state's law)
figure_or_rule_carried: For the KY taxable wage base, wages already paid by the employer (or predecessor) in 'covered employment' count, and covered employment includes service covered under any unemployment compensation law of another state: wages reported to another state reduce the KY 12,000 base for the same worker in the same calendar year. Answers the MULTI open question for KY.

instrument_name: Employer Guide to Kentucky UI 2026 re-read: liability thresholds, quarterly report due date, late penalties, interest
figure_or_rule_carried: Liability: non-agricultural 1,500 gross wages in a quarter or 1 worker in 20 weeks; agricultural 20,000 in a quarter or 10 workers in 20 weeks; domestic 1,000 in a quarter; 501(c)(3) 4 workers in 20 weeks (with KY work); corporate officers covered; family members of proprietors/partners (spouse, parent, child under 21) not covered. Quarterly wage report + payment in KUIP due last day of month after the quarter (zero reports required). Late report penalties: first 25 (75 if over 30 days), additional 125 (175 over 30 days); interest 1.5% per month. Rate notices mailed each December; schedule set by trust fund balance at Sept 30 of prior year.

instrument_name: KRS 405.435 New-hire reporting to the Office of the Attorney General
figure_or_rule_carried: Employers report each employee who resides or works in KY, hired or rehired/returned from layoff, furlough, separation, leave without pay or termination, within 20 days, to the Office of the Attorney General (moved from the Cabinet for Health and Family Services by 2023 Ky. Acts ch. 124 sec. 50, effective 2025-07-01). Content: employee name, address, SSN; employer name, address, federal and state EINs; first date services were performed. Medium: copy of W-4 or AG-prescribed equivalent form. Fine 250 per month per person only after two notices and conspiracy. Capture 20250310 shows the (Effective July 1, 2025) version.

instrument_name: KRS 337.010(2)(c)-(d) Gratuity and tipped-employee definitions (HB 185, 2026 Ky. Acts ch. 72)
figure_or_rule_carried: Tipped employee = customarily and regularly receives more than 30 USD/month in tips AND performs work that directly supports or is the tip-generating service function, or directly supports a service function with any customer interaction or in customers' line of sight. Effective 2026-04-10 (2026 Ky. Acts ch. 72 sec. 6); together with KRS 337.065 (sec. 7) permits mandatory tip pools including such tipped employees (bill number HB 185 from tier-B lead; Acts chapter from the statute history).

instrument_name: KRS 141.010(21) Internal Revenue Code conformity date
figure_or_rule_carried: For taxable years from 2026-01-01, 'Internal Revenue Code' = IRC in effect on 2025-12-31, excluding later amendments other than extensions of provisions in effect 2024-12-31. Withholding treatment chart of 42A003 (rev. 03-2026, US-KYS5-023) applies this conformity item by item. KY decoupling provisions in KRS 141.019/141.0101 not read. Section effective 2026-07-15 (2026 session conformity update; capture 20261012).

instrument_name: 42A003 (rev. March 2026) Kentucky Withholding Treatment chart (33 payment types) and Q&A
article_or_section: Section XII chart; XIII Q&A 3-4 and 9-10
figure_or_rule_carried: KY withholding: Required = agricultural wages* (taxable if federal-taxable under IRC 3121(a): cash under 150 and labour expense under 2,500 excluded), aliens, bonuses, company cars, directors/officers, severance, family employment, golden parachutes, moving expenses, nonprofit employees, sick pay*, tips over 20/month, vacation pay. Not Required = cafeteria plans, clergy, contractors, dependent care assistance, domestic workers, election workers, federal TSP*, flexible benefit plans, fringe benefits*, group-term life*, health care plans, IRA, loans, meals and lodging*, pensions (voluntary only), 401(k)*, scholarships, SEP*, third-party sick pay, travel expenses*. (* = conditions per federal rule; asterisk notes not printed in extracted text.) Out-of-state employers withhold on nonresidents' KY-earned wages unless reciprocal-state resident (103 KAR 18:010(2)); may voluntarily withhold for KY residents working outside KY. Mapping of 33 labels to 33 values done by order in the extracted text.

instrument_name: LFUCG Division of Revenue: occupational license fee rates, forms and filing requirements
authority: Lexington-Fayette Urban County Government Division of Revenue
article_or_section: Rates and current forms; minimum license and filing requirements (https://www.lexingtonky.gov/working/business-licensing-taxes/occupational-license-fee-minimum-license-filing-requirements)
figure_or_rule_carried: Lexington-Fayette occupational license fee 2.25% of an individual's compensation (and business net profits); withheld from employees' compensation and remitted by the employer; employee files only if under-withheld. Employer's Return of License Fee Withheld (Form 220-221, official preprinted copies mailed in January, not available online) quarterly for every employer with employees working in Lexington; monthly if quarterly withholding exceeds 300 USD; annual Reconciliation (Form 222, 2025 edition current); 1099-LX transmittal for non-employee compensation. Governing: LFUCG Code ch. 13; License Fee Regulations 5th ed. (2000-12-01). Initial and annual minimum license 100 USD (business).

instrument_name: KRS 118.035 Voting leave and election-officer leave
figure_or_rule_carried: Voter who applies before the day may be absent a reasonable time of not less than 4 hours to vote on election day (or to request/execute an absentee ballot at the clerk); employer may specify the hours; disciplinary action allowed if the employee does not vote without excuse. Election officers may be absent an entire day for training or service without penalty. No pay obligation stated in the text. Capture 20260807.

instrument_name: KRS 405.465 Income withholding for child support (employer fee, lump-sum notice) - statute text not read
authority: Kentucky Legislative Research Commission (text not reached; content from search summary)
figure_or_rule_carried: LEAD ONLY: employer may deduct 1 USD per payment made under the order; employers with 20+ employees notify of lump sums of 150 USD or more for an obligor under an IWO; termination notice to the agency with last address/new employer. Administered since 2025-07-01 by the Office of the Attorney General (Office of Child Support Services) per KRS 405.435 history [US-KYS5-020].
